scenarios.description: Standard 2-of-3 approval, 2-of-3 Ed25519 multisig signing, 2-block confirmation, and reconciliation.
Approved intent has destination address mutated prior to isolated signer verification; signer must refuse with ERR_INTENT_HASH_MISMATCH.
Intent with only 1 of 2 required approvals submitted to signer; signer must refuse with ERR_INSUFFICIENT_APPROVALS.
Duplicate intent ID, reused nonce, and replayed signed payload submitted to engine and signer; all replays blocked.
1 of 3 signers offline still meets 2-of-3 threshold; 2 of 3 offline fails closed with ERR_SIGNER_QUORUM_UNAVAILABLE; recovery restores signing.
Shallow block reorg orphans a confirming/settled transfer, custody engine detects divergence, reverts settlement, re-confirms on canonical fork, and reconciles cleanly.

Vault key epoch rotates from epoch 1 to epoch 2 while an approved epoch-1 intent is pending; pending intent is invalidated, stale-epoch signing is rejected with ERR_KEY_EPOCH_MISMATCH, funds are unreserved, and a new epoch-2 intent succeeds.
